text_en: Thus said the Lord to me, “Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth, and put it on your loins, but do not dip it in water. ”
text_cn: 上主对我这样说：“你去买条麻带，束在腰间，但是不要浸在水里。”

text_en: So I bought a loincloth according to the word of the Lord , and put it on my loins.
text_cn: 我就照上主的话去买了根麻带，束在腰间。

text_en: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying,
text_cn: 上主的话第二次传给我说：

text_en: “Take the loincloth that you bought and are wearing, and go now to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock. ”
text_cn: “拿你买来束在腰间的带子，起身往幼发拉的去，藏在那里的岩石缝里。”

text_en: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.
text_cn: 我照上主吩咐我的去了；将带子藏在幼发拉的近傍。

text_en: And after many days the Lord said to me, “Go now to the Euphrates, and take from there the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there. ”
text_cn: 过了多日，上主对我说：“你起身往幼发拉的去，拿回我吩咐你藏在那里的带子。”

text_en: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and I took the loincloth from the place where I had hidden it. But now the loincloth was ruined; it was good for nothing.
text_cn: 我便往幼发拉的去了，由我藏下的地方挖出那带子；看，已经腐烂，毫无用处了。

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 于是有上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Just so I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
text_cn: “上主这样说：我也要这样毁灭犹大的骄傲，和耶路撒冷极度的高傲。

text_en: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who stubbornly follow their own will and have gone after other gods to serve them and worship them, shall be like this loincloth, which is good for nothing.
text_cn: 这个拒绝听我的话，而随从自己固执的心行事，追随事奉，朝拜其他神祇的邪恶人民，必要如这毫无用处的带子一样。

text_en: For as the loincloth clings to one’s loins, so I made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to me, says the Lord , in order that they might be for me a people, a name, a praise, and a glory. But they would not listen.
text_cn: 因为正如带子紧贴在人的腰间，同样我也曾使以色列全家和犹大全家紧紧依附我──上主的断语──成为我的人民，我的名誉，我的赞美和我的光荣；但是他们却没有听从。

text_en: You shall speak to them this word: Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Every wine-jar should be filled with wine. And they will say to you, “Do you think we do not know that every wine-jar should be filled with wine? ”
text_cn: 你应向他们宣布这话：上主以色列的天主这样说：每个壶都应盛满酒。如果他们对你说：难道我们不知道，每个壶都应盛满酒吗？

text_en: Then you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord : I am about to fill all the inhabitants of this land—the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem—with drunkenness.
text_cn: 你就答复他们说：上主这样说：看，我要使这地上的一切居民，坐在达味宝座上的君王，以及司祭和先知并耶路撒冷的一切居民，都酩酊大醉，

text_en: And I will dash them one against another, parents and children together, says the Lord . I will not pity or spare or have compassion when I destroy them.
text_cn: 使他们彼此冲突，连父子也彼此冲突──上主的断语──我毫不怜悯、不慈悲、不留情地将他们消灭。”

text_en: Hear and give ear; do not be haughty, for the Lord has spoken.
text_cn: 你们侧耳聆听，不要傲慢，因为是上主在说话。

text_en: Give glory to the Lord your God before he brings darkness, and before your feet stumble on the mountains at twilight; while you look for light, he turns it into gloom and makes it deep darkness.
text_cn: 黑暗来临以前，在你们的脚还没有在黑暗中撞在山石上以前，应将光荣归于上主你们的天主；不然，你们期待光明，他反发放死影，使它变得漆黑。

text_en: But if you will not listen, my soul will weep in secret for your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly and run down with tears, because the Lord ’s flock has been taken captive.
text_cn: 假使你们还不听从这警告，对你的骄傲，我只有暗自痛哭，眼泪直流，因为上主的羊群已被掳去。

text_en: Say to the king and the queen mother: “Take a lowly seat, for your beautiful crown has come down from your head. ”
text_cn: 你应对君王和太后说：“你们应坐低位，因为你们华丽的王冠已由你们头上落下。”

text_en: The towns of the Negeb are shut up with no one to open them; all Judah is taken into exile, wholly taken into exile.
text_cn: 南部的城邑已被封锁，没有人去打开，全犹大已被掳去，全被掳去。

text_en: Lift up your eyes and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?
text_cn: 请你举目观望那来自北方的人；昔日委托给你的羊群，那壮丽的羊群，如今在哪里？

text_en: What will you say when they set as head over you those whom you have trained to be your allies? Will not pangs take hold of you, like those of a woman in labor?
text_cn: 他惩罚你，你还有什么话说？是你教导了昔日的盟友来统治你，岂能不使你痛苦得像个临产的妇女？

text_en: And if you say in your heart, “Why have these things come upon me? ” it is for the greatness of your iniquity that your skirts are lifted up, and you are violated.
text_cn: 假使你心里说：为什么我遭遇了这些事？──是因你罪大恶极，你的衣边才被掀起，你的脚跟才受到污辱。

text_en: Can Ethiopians change their skin or leopards their spots? Then also you can do good who are accustomed to do evil.
text_cn: 雇士人岂能改变他的肤色，豹子岂能改变它的斑点？那你们这些习于作恶的人，岂能行善！

text_en: I will scatter you like chaff driven by the wind from the desert.
text_cn: 为此，我必使他们四散，像被旷野里的风卷去的草芥。

text_en: This is your lot, the portion I have measured out to you, says the Lord , because you have forgotten me and trusted in lies.
text_cn: 这是你的命运，是我量给你的分子──上主的断语──因为你忘记了我，信赖了“虚无”；

text_en: I myself will lift up your skirts over your face, and your shame will be seen.
text_cn: 故此我也要将你的衣边掀到你面上，使人见到你的羞耻。

text_en: I have seen your abominations, your adulteries and neighings, your shameless prostitutions on the hills of the countryside. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will it be before you are made clean?
text_cn: 你的奸淫，你春情的嘶鸣，你猥亵的淫乱，你在高丘上和田野间可耻的行为，我都看见了。祸哉，耶路撒冷！你不肯自洁，要到何时？
